sn45.25:1.1: Savatthi || || Tatravoca || || Asappurisañ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sappurisañ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamo ca bhikkhave asappuriso || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti || micchāsaṅkappo micchāvāco micchākammanto micchāājīvo micchāvāyāmo micchāsati micchāsamādhi || || Ayam vuccati bhikkhave asappuriso || ||
sn45.25:2.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave sappuriso || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti || sammāsaṅkappo sammāvāco sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi || || Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sappuriso ti || || 1.2. Sāvatthi || ||
